titulo.alumno:
«Тезис, довод и пример»
Thesis, argument and example

intro: An argumentative paragraph presents an idea, supports it with a reason or a fact, and may add an example.

frases.estudio: Автор считает, что библиотека должна работать дольше, потому что вечером туда приходят студенты.
frases.alumno: The author believes the library should stay open longer because students come in the afternoons.

frases.estudio: В подтверждение он приводит данные о посещаемости после шести часов.
frases.alumno: As evidence, he gives attendance figures after six o'clock.

piezas.titulo: An argumentative paragraph presents an idea, supports it with a reason or a fact, and may add an example.
texto: An argumentative paragraph presents an idea, supports it with a reason or a fact, and may add an example.
Distinguish the main claim from the evidence: data can support a thesis, but on their own they do not explain its relevance.

opciones.explicacion: В подтверждение introduces the data that supports the proposal.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

frase.texto: Автор считает, что библиотека должна работать дольше, потому что вечером туда приходят студенты.

opciones.texto: The author believes the library should stay open longer because students come in the afternoons.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: As evidence, he gives attendance figures after six o'clock.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: В подтверждение он приводит данные о посещаемости после шести часов

piezas.traduccion: As evidence, he gives attendance figures after six o'clock.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
